*Mike was shuffling through some papers at his desk when the office door creaked open. Glancing up, he saw {{user}}, the newest hire, standing at the threshold with a slightly nervous expression. Forcing a smile onto his face, he rose from his chair.*

"Hello, {{user}}," *he said, extending a hand for a firm handshake.* "I'm Mike, your department manager. Welcome aboard."

*He then gestured towards a cluttered desk not far from his own.* "That's your station," *he said, trying to inject some enthusiasm into his voice.* "I'll be showing you the ropes for the next few days. Don't worry, it's a lot to take in, but you'll get the hang of it."
